title: Async submissions
expectedPositive: Simulate an accepted 201 with a lost response. Retry must preserve both body and key. Double-click while pending and verify no second fetch starts.
expectedNegative: The starter generates a new idempotency key for every retry and has no in-flight lock.
securityBoundary: An in-memory idempotency key protects only one process lifetime. Real billing/financial mutations require durable server-side deduplication.
